name: Trawl
author: Mathi5
short_desc: Self-hosted scraping engine: resolves Cloudflare/captcha challenges to hand clean pages to scrapers and firewalls. FlareSolverr-compatible.
description: Self-hosted TRAWL: web scraping engine that bypasses JS challenges and captchas (Cloudflare, Turnstile, reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, GeeTest) and hands resolved pages to API clients or agents. FlareSolverr-compatible /v1 for Prowlarr and the *arr stack, native MCP server, optional challenge-bypassing forward proxy for Firecrawl (PROXY_SERVER), metrics dashboard. Camoufox-based.

form_fields.label: Dashboard token (32+ chars, protects the dashboard when enabled)
Enable the challenge-bypassing forward proxy (port 8192)
form_fields.hint: OFF by default. Set to true only to route scraper clients (e.g. Firecrawl PROXY_SERVER, Prowlarr indexers) through it. When on, import its CA into the client: GET http://<trawl>:8191/proxy-ca.crt (see description.md).

form_fields.label: MITM max escalation tier
form_fields.hint: Cap for the forward proxy: 1=HTTP only, 2=cached browser, 3=fresh solve, 4=residential (only if configured). Keep at 3 unless you run Tier 4.

form_fields.label: Browser pool size (warm Camoufox instances)
form_fields.hint: Warms full Firefox instances — each costs ~500 MB RAM on solve. Keep at 1 unless you solve challenges concurrently.

form_fields.label: Firefox content processes per browser
form_fields.hint: dom.ipc.processCount cap. 2 keeps a solve burst under ~1.5 GB RAM; raise only on beefy hosts.

form_fields.label: Headful browser sub-pool (DataDome targets)
form_fields.hint: 0 = disabled (default). Set 1 to scrape DataDome-protected sites (leboncoin-style Device Check walls): launches a headful Camoufox behind Xvfb, ~380 MB extra RAM. Leave 0 if you have no DataDome target.

form_fields.label: Tier 3 datacenter/HTTP proxy (optional)
form_fields.hint: http://user:pass@host:port or socks5://… Empty = disabled. Comma-separated for a pool.

form_fields.label: Tier 4 residential proxy (optional)
form_fields.hint: Enables the Tier 4 escalation. Empty = disabled. Most self-hosts never need it: a clean residential fixed IP already passes IP reputation checks.

form_fields.label: Session cache driver
form_fields.hint: memory (default) or redis. memory = sessions lost on app restart; a fresh solve happens on demand (cheap). redis requires the REDIS_URL below.

form_fields.label: Redis URL (only if Redis cache enabled)
form_fields.hint: e.g. redis://<redis-container>:6379 — another Runtipi app's container name + INTERNAL port. Only used when the Redis toggle above is ON.

form_fields.label: Enable the MCP scraping endpoint (/mcp)
form_fields.hint: Exposes Streamable-HTTP MCP tools (readable content, HTML, structured extraction, screenshots) for MCP clients (Hermes, OpenWebUI…). LAN only.
